title: Asymptotic minimization of the first Dirichlet eigenvalue in a square with two hard obstacles
summary: We study an asymptotic minimization problem for the first Dirichlet eigenvalue in the square $Q=(-1,1)^2$, where two equal hard circular obstacles of radius $r$ move inside $Q$ with disjoint interiors; tangency between the obstacles and with the outer boundary is allowed. We prove that, as $r\to0$, every minimizing configuration approaches, up to the symmetries of the square and interchange of the holes, a pair of corner-tangent obstacles at adjacent corners, with displacement $o(r)$ from the corresponding corner-tangent centers.
